title: Table Card
description: A sortable data table, optionally with schema-validated row and/or column actions.

actions.description: Column-scoped actions rendered inline within this column's cells. A response for one of these carries both action_id and column_key. Presence of any column action makes the table interactive (see root-level `actions` for the addressability requirement).

rows.description: Row data. Keys must match column keys.

actions.description: Row-scoped actions rendered as a button group on every row. A response for one of these carries action_id and row_index (no column_key). Interactive tables (root-level `actions` and/or any column `actions`) must be emitted through a path that persists an EnvelopeInstance (e.g. the same emit mechanism approval-card/elicitation-prompt use) so the envelope has an id the frontend can POST a response against — the passive card_show path does not create one.

id.description: Stable action identifier. Echoed back verbatim as `action_id` in the response payload posted to POST /api/envelopes/{id}/respond. Not shown to the user.

style.description: Visual emphasis. Defaults to "default" (a subtle/secondary button).

confirm.description: When true, the client asks the user to confirm before submitting the response. Defaults to false.

confirm_message.description: Message shown in the confirmation prompt. Only meaningful when confirm is true.
